name: fittrack
description: FitTrack - Gym Calorie Deficit & Fat-Loss Tracker

scripts.dev:server: node api.js && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.dev:client: node api.js && npm run dev --prefix client
scripts.dev: node api.js && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
